decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and launched as a multi-model line with its own page, it has visible investment and the vague feedback can still be attributed to temporary causes, so escalation favors keeping it.

As the home-page flagship and declared focus of the firm's direction, it carries strong public commitment and central investment, so dropping it would write off visible resources and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
Although less central and with only a page of its own, it is close to the established offer and too early to attribute any disappointing results to permanent causes, so the firm is likely to keep it.
